I hold a degree in <1>Systems Analysis and Development</1> from the Federal Institute of São Paulo (IFSP) and a technical degree in Informatics from FIEB.

I have experience with <1>Vue.js</1>, <1>React</1>, <1>JavaScript</1>, <1>HTML</1>, <1>CSS</1>, and consuming back-end services. I am also deepening my studies in <1>QA</1>, focused on testing, best practices, and continuous improvement of application quality.

Development following best practices, code standards, and agile workflows, with attention to quality, usability, and continuous improvement of applications.
